rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice, especially for an organized debate or a discussion between opposing sides.

example.english: There is a debate at school tomorrow, and everyone will vote to decide which team wins in the end.
example.traditional: 聽日學校有場辯論，最後由大家投票決定邊隊勝出。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 hok6 haau6 jau5 coeng4 bin6 leon6 zeoi3 hau6 jau4 daai6 gaa1 tau4 piu3 kyut3 ding6 bin1 deoi6 sing3 ceot1

rows.note: Use this for an informal, generally civil discussion of different views rather than a formal debate with a vote.

example.english: We had a debate about where to travel while eating.
example.traditional: 我哋食飯嗰陣，為咗去邊度旅行討論咗一輪。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6 go2 zan6 wai6 zo2 heoi3 bin1 dou6 leoi5 hang4 tou2 leon6 zo2 jat1 leon4

rows.note: Use this when the debate emphasizes people arguing over opposing views, even if they remain civil.

example.english: They had a debate all morning over which proposal was better.
example.traditional: 佢哋為咗邊個方案好，爭論咗成朝。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 bin1 go3 fong1 on3 hou2 zang1 leon6 zo2 seng4 ziu1
